_comment: Games verified on the Frame and what they need beyond the generic fixes (agent/fexrift.py load_games).
A game's exe and launch arguments come from its Meta manifest when it isn't listed here; the generic fix for
Unreal's IME deadlock (find_ime_patch) is found in the binaries, ime_patch here is only the fallback when the
finder misses (exe RVA, expected bytes, new bytes). Opt-ins only safe for a game they were checked with stay per
game: fp_mem's big-block cache hands memory back unzeroed; msaa_ini lets --msaa write the game's Engine.ini.

oculus-first-contact.title: Oculus First Contact
oculus-first-contact._env: Unreal's large-block allocator gives 0.5-1.6 GB blocks back every few seconds and this game overwrites them completely: fp_mem keeps them (native/fexwine/fp_mem.c)
